title: private-deployments-weekly-2026-05-11
content:
Private Deployments — Engineering Weekly
Week of 2026-05-11
Owner: Aisha Patel
Status: In review
Attendees: Aisha, Marcus, Elena, Ravi, Sofia, infra on-call (Tyler)

Summary
- Focus this week: unblock three customer installs (HealthCo, FinServ Inc, RetailCorp), stabilize the air-gapped installer, and complete the PKI/cert rotation design for VPC customers.
- Progress on operator Helm v2 -> v3 migration and automated preflight checks (CIDR, KMS access, node labels).
- Ongoing blocker: intermittent CUDA/NVIDIA driver mismatches observed on customer on-prem clusters causing model server crashes under load.

Accomplishments
1) HealthCo (VPC deployment)
   - Completed VPC peering validation with customer's network team; discovered overlapping CIDR for mgmt plane (10.1.0.0/16 vs their 10.1.0.0/24). Documented workaround and recommended reassigning mgmt CIDR on their side. Ticket PD-1124 created for tracking.
   - Applied temporary NAT rule change to allow control-plane egress for installer; install completed to 80% (remaining: metrics agent failing to register).

2) FinServ Inc (air-gapped on-prem)
   - Air-gapped installer: fixed container registry packaging for sidecar images; added checksum validation to avoid silent corruptions during transfer.
   - Discovered missing /etc/ssl/openssl.cnf on customer's bastion host causing the certgen step to fail. Added clearer preflight check and remediation steps. Installer v0.9.3 published (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/private-deployments/pull/412).

3) RetailCorp (on-prem Kubernetes)
   - Model-server crashes reproduced in our lab: root cause narrowed to NVIDIA driver 535.x incompatibility with our custom tensor-kernel. Recommending customers install 530.x LTS driver or use container runtime flag to disable optimized kernel path until hotfix lands.
   - Temporary mitigation documented for customer: CPU fallback profile + scaled worker pools.

4) Internal tooling and infra
   - Helm chart v3.1.0 released with improved values schema for storage and cert secrets.
   - Preflight CLI added 'cidr-check' and 'ssl-check' steps; docs page created (Confluence: PD-Private-Deployments-Weekly-Notes).

Blockers and Risks
- CUDA/NVIDIA driver mismatches: multiple customers on older on-prem stacks running driver 535.x are experiencing model-server SIGSEGVs under sustained load. We need to finalize a kernel fallback path or ship a patched libquant kernel. Risk: impacts committed Dedicated SLAs if customers upgrade drivers without coordination.
- KMS/HSM integration test flaky for KMS provider X when customer uses split routing. Root cause suspected in STS token refresh logic behind NAT. Pending escalations with security team (ticket PD-1178).
- Certificate rotation design: customers with strict firewall egress policies require a pull-based cert sync; current push design fails when control-plane cannot initiate connections. Design doc in progress; delays impact automated rotation feature for Q3 customers.

Standup notes (daily highlights)
- 2026-05-11: HealthCo peering validated; NAT rules workaround implemented; metrics agent failing to register — Marcus to follow up with HealthCo SRE.
- 2026-05-12: Air-gapped installer fix merged; Elena to coordinate package transfer for FinServ.
- 2026-05-12 afternoon: Repro for driver crash completed in lab; Ravi started work on kernel fallback branch.

Action Items (owners and ETA)
- Marcus Lee: finish metrics agent registration fix for HealthCo and close PD-1124 (ETA: 2026-05-13).
- Elena Garcia: run full air-gapped transfer with FinServ and confirm install success, document transfer checklist (ETA: 2026-05-14).
- Ravi Menon: prototype libquant fallback (disable optimized kernels) and benchmark CPU fallback cost impact; open PR for hotfix (ETA: 2026-05-18).
- Sofia Alvarez: finalize cert-rotation design for restricted-egress customers; present design to security and product next week (ETA: 2026-05-19).
- Tyler (infra on-call): escalate KMS STS token refresh failure to security; gather logs from affected customers (ETA: 2026-05-12).

Customer Communications (what we told customers)
- HealthCo: temporary NAT workaround in place; we requested a small CIDR change for long-term fix. We committed to follow up on metrics agent by 2026-05-13.
- FinServ Inc: provided patched installer v0.9.3 and transfer checklist; requested verification window to complete validation.
- RetailCorp: provided driver compatibility guidance (recommend 530.x) and a temporary CPU fallback profile; offered a walkthrough for the hotfix once available.

Meeting notes (2026-05-12 sync with security & product)
- Topic: cert rotation and KMS integration for restricted networks.
- Security asks for explicit threat model and audit trail for pull-based cert sync; product emphasized need for zero-downtime rotation for enterprise customers.
- Decision: build dual-mode rotation (push where allowed, pull for restricted) and add audit logs for each rotation event. Action: Sofia to draft design, security to review.

Notes to self / follow-ups
- Add a quick-playbook for driver mismatch: detection heuristics in logs + immediate mitigation steps (restart with CPU fallback).
- Improve installer preflight to catch missing openssl and required kernel modules earlier.
- Schedule a focused troubleshooting session with NVIDIA partner engineer to discuss driver 535.x breakage and timeline for a vendor fix.

Related tickets / PRs
- PD-1124: HealthCo CIDR peering and metrics agent registration
- PD-1178: KMS STS token refresh failure (escalation to security)
- PR #412: air-gapped installer fixes and checksum validation (https://github.com/redwood-inference/private-deployments/pull/412)
- Helm release: v3.1.0 (packaging tag: v3.1.0)

Next week's focus
- Deliver driver fallback hotfix and publish mitigation KB article.
- Complete cert-rotation dual-mode design and get security sign-off.
- Drive installs to completion for HealthCo and FinServ, close associated tickets.

Appendix: quick runbook excerpts
- Preflight checklist summary: K8s 1.24+, kubeadm/eksctl supported, required kernel modules (aufs/overlay), docker/containerd version, NVIDIA driver compatibility matrix, /etc/ssl presence for certgen, reachable KMS endpoints.
- Emergency rollback: command set to scale down model-server replicas, switch to CPU-only deployment profile, and route traffic to standby model-variant.

End of note
